label: Mission

projection.consumedFor: work/mission/task lineage rows, desired vs observed state, dependencies, blockers, typed gaps, proof requirement, receipt coverage

lineage.join: explicit ids only: mission.workId, contains edges (work→mission, mission→task), and mission.taskIds; never name/title joins
lineage.order: missions are deduplicated by missionId and stable-sorted by missionId before the 24-row bound; tasks render only through explicit mission.taskIds membership, in sorted-mission order then declared taskIds order, deduplicated by taskId; contains edges are deduplicated and sorted by kind/fromId/toId before bounding — input order never changes visible truth
lineage.lookupSafety: browser lookup dictionaries are prototype-safe (Object.create(null)) and Node lookups use Map, so hostile ids such as __proto__, constructor, or prototype never corrupt membership or coverage

fields.desired: work.desiredState / mission.objective / task.desiredState rendered as the desired fact
fields.observed: work lifecycle-or-status / mission.status / task.status rendered as the observed fact
fields.dependencies: union of task.dependencyIds and depends-on edges from the projection, deduplicated and sorted; dependencies are never labelled blockers
fields.receiptCoverage: boolean coverage only: task.latestReceiptId counts only when it resolves to a canonical receipt node; an edge counts only as an exact produces/proves edge whose fromId is a canonical receiptId and whose toId is the taskId — a reversed task-to-receipt edge never counts; when multiple valid receipt edges name one task the lexicographically smallest receiptId renders deterministically while coverage stays boolean; arbitrary last-receipt-by-taskId is never used; readiness is never invented
fields.blockers: only when task.status is exactly blocked: detail of typed blocker gaps (kind blocker/blocked/missing-blocker) naming the task as subjectId; the honest label 'blocker detail missing' when no typed gap carries detail
fields.proofRequirement: task/mission proofRequirement when non-empty; otherwise the explicit honest label 'proof requirement missing' — never an invented 'proof required'

derivation.empty: no work selected, selected work absent from the projection, or the lineage has no missions/tasks
derivation.truncated: missions/tasks/edges exceed the 24-row lineage bound; overflow renders as an explicit typed state

density.bounds: lineage lists and edge rows stay bounded at 24 and deterministically ordered; overflow is an explicit typed state, never silent drops

authority.governedActions: every governed action delegates to the existing signed Gate client (POST /api/gate/{tenant}) via its frozen hook; this slice exposes no safe hook, so the scene renders an honest read-only governed-action cue and defers activation wiring to Task 11
authority.forbidden: no copied signing, no initData handling, no POST path, no permission ladder, and no client-authored state transitions inside the scene client

interactions.effect: lineage re-renders for the local selectedWorkId

accessibility.structure: lineage rows are ordered lists of articles with labelled facts; the governed cue is plain text, never a fake active control
accessibility.announcements: empty/error states use role=status via the shared FabricState renderer

redaction: no initData, tokens, raw evidence refs, prompt material, or client payloads render; receipt coverage renders ids and counts only; every projection-derived string passes the Task 7 escaping/fail-closed policy. The Node substrate embeds the canonical Task 7 signature regex VERBATIM (query_id=|auth_date=|\bhash=|Bearer\s|bot_token|clientSecret|initData|TELEGRAM_INIT_DATA|TG_INIT_DATA|QUESTS_PUSH_TOKEN|token=|PRIVATE KEY|\bprompt\s*[:=]|prompt\s+injection); the served browser substrate expresses the same policy as a legible normalized grammar — (?:query_id|auth_date|token)=|(?:^|\W)(?:hash)= plus the remaining explicit canonical terms — that keeps query_id/auth_date/token unanchored and the hash word boundary exactly like the canonical policy while never containing the contiguous raw-audit hash= literal; boolean equivalence is proven by a generated adversarial matrix (prefixes × assignment signatures × suffixes, case variants, benign near misses) with zero divergences; no character-class fragmentation, no split/concatenated forms
